urdu.name: نبیلہ

faq.q: What is the origin of Nabeelah?
faq.a: Nabeelah is associated with Arabic. Nabeelah is Arabic نَبِيلَة (Nabīla) 'noble, high-born' (feminine), from the root ن ب ل (n-b-l). The source gloss 'Companion of the Prophet' is a historical association rather than a lexical sense. Same name as nabila.

faq.a: In Persian, Nabeelah is rendered نبيله and carries the sense نبيله، نجیب (مؤنث).

faq.a: Romanization variants include Nabeelah, nabeelah. Script forms are نبيله, نبیلہ, نَبِيلَة, नबीला.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
